categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and updates `src/test/sock_tests.cpp` to properly handle partial socket reads.
categories.rationale: Fixes latent test flakiness by reading socket data in a loop rather than assuming atomic delivery in a single `Recv()` call. While partial reads are improbable in standard loopback CI, the test fails deterministically under chunked socket transmission (PR description, Pranav-error review).
